brief:
Israeli forces killed 10 Palestinians, including a couple and their two children, during a series of attacks across Gaza between September 7 and 10, the Palestinian Centre for Human Rights reported. The strikes wounded dozens of additional civilians and destroyed residential structures including homes and tents, forcing families to flee their dwellings.

Researchers from PCHR documented the incidents during the four-day period. The organization provided no further detail on specific locations, dates, or operational circumstances surrounding individual attacks. The reported toll adds to the broader toll of violence in the territory.
dek: The Israeli Occupation Forces (IOF) killed 10 Palestinians, including a couple and their two children, and injured dozens more in a series of attacks documented by Palestinian Centre for Human Rights (PCHR) field researchers between 7 and 10 September 2026. The attacks also destroyed homes and tents and forcibly displaced families.
title: Israel kills 10 Palestinians including family of four in Gaza
